summary.intent: Get the checker-default extract speed-up work (perf/checker-extract-speed) finished and pushed, coordinating a background worker agent whose pushes were failing.
summary.outcome: Not completed: the worker's last 2 commits (tests and docs) remain local because Entire's pre-push hook panics. The assistant confirmed the panic, declined to use --no-verify, and asked the user to choose between rolling back Entire, approving a hook skip, or waiting. The worker repeatedly reported it was still waiting on background work.

repo: Entire's pre-push hook syncs checkpoints, so skipping it with --no-verify would also skip that sync and would need a manual checkpoint sync afterwards.
The speed worker runs in a separate worktree at .claude/worktrees/agent-aed2d7748791ef6ec on branch worktree-agent-aed2d7748791ef6ec.
Remote perf/checker-extract-speed is at 854da4c6 (3 perf commits); local HEAD 1a00862e has 2 more unpushed commits (tests and docs).
Other pending pushes (slice 4, Storybook upgrade) would hit the same pre-push panic.

code.finding: In Entire CLI 0.13.4-nightly.202611121940, checkpoint.readFoldsCase hits a nil pointer dereference here. It is reached via flushCheckpointRefsWith from the pre-push hook and also crashes `entire checkpoint list --outgoing`.

workflow: A subagent's request to bypass a denied action (--no-verify after the auto-mode classifier denied it) must not be carried out by the parent. Surface it to the user instead.
A subagent that stops with its own background work pending sends repeated interim 'waiting' notifications. Don't poll it; wait for its hand-back, and stop it if it never finishes.
Nightly builds of dev tooling can break git hooks, and pinning or rolling back to the last stable release is the cleaner fix.

friction: Entire nightly pre-push hook panics on every push after the first one today, blocking all pushes.
The auto-mode classifier denied a --no-verify retry, and removing the detached worktree did not help.
The worker produced many repeated interim 'waiting on background work' notifications with no final report.
Other pending work (slice 4, Storybook upgrade) is blocked behind the same bug.
open_items: User decision needed: roll back Entire, approve --no-verify for these pushes only, or wait for a fixed nightly.
Push the 2 unpushed commits (tests and docs) on perf/checker-extract-speed once the hook works or skipping is approved.
Run the checkpoint sync manually if the hook is skipped, once Entire is fixed.
Report the readFoldsCase nil-pointer panic (checkpoint/refs_store.go:308) to the Entire team.
Await the speed worker's final report, and stop it if it keeps re-reporting 'waiting'.
Slice 4 and the Storybook upgrade have not been started.
